additional_info.subject: ID0377447-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / R2 170001452] - AC charging interrupts CRM:00315001723
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Markus,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R2 170001452
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
Ib549u
Problem Description
: AC charging is stopped due to contactor being opened.
Troubleshooting
:
As this pertains to the AC charging, we need to troubleshoot the following devices:
In terms of Hardware:
First, on the right most side, we should have 24V coming out of KF13 (StateMonitor) SuO 4 until the QA8. We should check if there is a drop here that makes the QA8 open. From KF2 we also might lose 24V to KF13.
Second, on the middle, there is a feedback of the contactor which sends to the KF5 saying if it's actually closed or not, we need to see if there is a drop of continuity here between 13-14, since the charging works I assume that 24V are reaching but for some reason it opens.
Third, the main AC contactor of the QA8 is opening.
Since we only have one error flag for the closing it will be a bit hard to troubleshoot as it will take sometime.
In terms of software:
Possibly the StateMonitor can also stop the sessions, I need to see if there are EcoG logs for AC sessions (not sure).
What is your opinion? How should we go about testing? Is the customer available to bring a car to live test this issue?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0377447
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
